row.name: Incyte Corp. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=34 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.42 tightness=0.84 base_volume_vs_leg=0.7 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 34 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.42 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -0.9% vs its 20-SMA, 1.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is 34 sessions long with a giveback of 0.42 — visually confirmed as a wide, choppy consolidation box spanning roughly mid-July through early September with multiple overlapping bars and no tightening; this is not a Bonde-style compact pause but a prolonged sideways churn. The burst bar itself shows no range expansion (only 0.85x the prior 5-bar range) and volume came in below the prior session and well below the 50-session average, so there is no expansion of either range or volume to signal institutional participation. Three independent checklist failures (C, RE, VOL) all point to the same conclusion: the move has stalled, not paused.
claude.key_risk: INCY is a biotech with a 34-session base that has already given back 42% of the prior leg, meaning the trend energy is largely spent and any adverse headline could accelerate the decline through the base low.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below today's burst close (~124.75) or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the entry ceiling, as there is no volume or range expansion to support follow-through.

row.summary: INCY: +2.5% on 0.9× volume out of a base 12.7% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
